_comment: All dependencies use environment variable-based URL configuration for offline/air-gapped builds. Set the corresponding *_ARCHIVE_URL env var to an intranet mirror or local file path before running prepare-bundled. See scripts/prepare-bundled.ps1 for details.

jdtls-linux.name: Eclipse JDT Language Server
jdtls-linux._comment: 版本锁定为 1.55.0 (2026-01-13)，与 runtime-agent/internal/jdtls/distribution.go 的 JDTLSVersion 常量保持一致；详见 ADR-0017（JDT LS 版本兼容性矩阵）

jdk17-linux.name: Eclipse Temurin JDK 17
jdk17-linux._comment: JDK 17 for the debug bridge. Set KAIRO_JDK17_LINUX_ARCHIVE_URL to a local/intranet archive (.tar.gz) for pre-bundling.

jdk17-macos.name: Eclipse Temurin JDK 17
jdk17-macos._comment: JDK 17 for the debug bridge on macOS (x64 or aarch64). Set KAIRO_JDK17_MACOS_ARCHIVE_URL.

jdk17-windows.name: Eclipse Temurin JDK 17
jdk17-windows._comment: JDK 17 for the debug bridge on Windows (x64). Set KAIRO_JDK17_WINDOWS_ARCHIVE_URL to a local/intranet archive (.zip) for pre-bundling.
